english.note: This is the all-purpose choice when a person, idea, or matter is pushed aside and given less importance.

examples.english: We always relegate this issue to the sidelines instead of dealing with it seriously.
examples.traditional: 我哋成日將呢個問題擺埋一邊，唔認真處理。
